translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Ani Pablo, Jesucristo-nuggi-an-sunmakedba eskaryagi an mellesiid. Gwenad-Timoteo-anbo we-garda Filemónse anmar narmaksiid. Filemón, be an-gwenad-nue-sabedid, degine, be anba Jesús-igargi arbamogad-duled.

Degine, anmar narmakbar, bun-Apiase, a anmar nue-sabed, degine, Arquipo anmarba-arbaed-dulese anmar narmakbalid, deginbali, be-neggi Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunoni-damaladse anmar narmakbalid.
Bab Dummad, anmar-Baba, degi, Dummad-Jesucristo, amar bitigi bemargi nued binsamalana-gadin, degine, ulubgi bogidik bemar-itogega imakbalina-yerban.
Filemón gwenadgan-nue-sabed, degi, Jesúsgi nue bensurbalid
Filemón, Bab Dummadse an goter, begi an binsader, dog-nuedye an Bab Dummadga sogde-daed,
ar ade an be-itoged be Dummad-Jesús, degi, egi-akananaimalad nue sabed, degine, egi nue-bensuli be nanadibalid.

Andi an bega Bab Dummadse gornaid, bitigi Bab-Jesúsgi-bensuli-be-sunmaked, gatik dulemar nue ulubgi mag itononikina-gadin, belagwapa ibmar-nuegan bemar nikmaladi, we Cristo-Jesúsgi-bela-bemar-nikmalad.
Be gwenadgan-sabedba, anmar nue-weligwar itoged, degine, anmar-gwage nue ogannolenonibalid. Gwenad, ar ade, be-ulale, gwenadgan-Jesucristogi-akananaimalad nue gwage gannales-gunonikid.
Pablo, Onésimo-ular Filemónga sunmaksad
Degisoggu, Cristo-nuggi-an-barmilealid-ular sunna sabsur ibmar an bega sogenad, ibi be imaker-gebe,
degi-inigwele, ani, Pablo, bato selebagus, degine, Jesucristo-nuggi-sunmaked-ular eskaryagi an mellesiid, an bese sabedgine, wilesakwaa an egis,
an-machi-Onésimo, an wegi-eskaryagi-mellesiidgi an-machiga gunonikid, Bab-Jesús-abingasad-ular. Aga na bese egis.
We, be-mai-Onésimo, iduardi gwen ibmar-nuedga bega gussulid, emigindi bega, degine, anga, ibmar-nuedga gunonimalad.
We Onésimo, gannar an bese barmided. Degisoggu, an-abinganaiyob we-dule be abingaoed.
An Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi an sunmakdiid-ular, an eskaryagi mellesisoggu, Onésimo wegi an obebiendo, adi be-anar an-bendakegar.
Ar be-wichuli ibmar yapa an imakgusad, adi melle be-anga-ibmar-imaked an bega-ise-sogar-sogedba be imakegar, suli, degisuli, adi na be-itolegedba be anga imakegar.
Ar a-ular Onésimo begi-sikwas wis bangussursi, adi emigi degi-sadegu be abingaegar,

Onésimo mer maiyob bar be abingaoed. Suli, degisuli. Aba bur-bule be dakoed, gwenad-nue-sabe be abingaoed. We-gwenad nue an sabed, be bur-bule sabgu an insado. Unnila sanarsulid, burbar Bab-Jesúsgi be-gwenadbalid.
An bebo-arbaed be an-dakele, an-abinganaiyob Onésimo be abingaodo.
Degine, bei-ibmar ichosale, igi, begi mani-ganikile, an-nuggi be nasikoed.
Ani Pablo, an-sunnad an-argangi an bega narmaksiid, an-sunnad an be-bennukoye, ar an mer bega sogegar, be-sunnad angi be-san-burba be ganimogad.
Eye, gwenad, anmar Cristogi gwenadgan gumarsoggu, Bab-Jesús-nuggi weligwar an itogegala gwenad-Onésimo be abingasun. Deyob be imaksale, nue be an-gwage ogannogoed.
An bese garda narmaksado, ar an wisid an-bega-ibmar-sogedba be ibmar imakoed, degine, aba bur-bule be imakbalo an insado.
An-megoed guagwar be anga sioed, ar an wisid bemar anga Bab-Dummadse-goled-ular an eskaryagi-siid nabir an nooed, geb degi bemarse an ataknaoed.
Epafras, anbo eskaryagi Cristo-Jesús-nug-ular mellesiid bega sogdo, be nued sogeye.
Degine, Marcos, Aristarco, Demas, Lucas, anba-arbamalad, be nued sogeye bega sogmarmogad.
Dummad-Jesucristo bitigi nued bemar-burbagi binsamalana-gadin. Be itomargua.
